task_description: Implements the bubble sort algorithm, which repeatedly swaps adjacent inverted elements to arrange the array in ascending order. This method ensures the final array is fully sorted while preserving the original multiset, serving as a typical case for formal verification of sorting algorithms.

test_cases.test_1: var A1 := new int[3]; A1[0], A1[1], A1[2] := 3, 1, 2; var res1 := sorted_between(A1, 0, 2); assert res1 == false;
test_cases.test_2: var A2 := new int[4]; A2[0], A2[1], A2[2], A2[3] := 1, 2, 3, 4; var res2 := sorted_between(A2, 0, 3); assert res2 == true;
test_cases.test_3: var A3 := new int[5]; A3[0], A3[1], A3[2], A3[3], A3[4] := 1, 3, 2, 5, 4; var res3 := sorted_between(A3, 1, 3); assert res3 == false;
